profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Dot & Bracket Co. | JavaScript, TypeScript, React & Node.js - Cloud on AWS | Interested in Software Architecture & AI Coding
profile.summary:
Software Engineer specializing in TypeScript and React. I developed the theming system for Bread Financial that enabled the onboarding of The Royal Bank of Canada, a key client within a $3.89B annual revenue ecosystem serving 600+ B2B customers. Interested in performance and architecture.

Skills and technologies:
Frontend: React - JavaScript - TypeScript - Artificial Intelligence - CSS - User Experience - HTML - Responsive Web Design - Web Accessibility - REST APIs - Continuous Integration - Git - Technical Documentation - Cross-functional Collaboration - Performance Optimization - Design Systems - State Management - GitHub - Data Visualization - Redux - Unit Testing - Jest - Figma - Tailwind CSS - Web Performance - ECMAScript - Bootstrap - Context API - Continuous Delivery - Core Web Vitals - ESLint - JSON - Lazy Loading - Material UI - Mobile-First Design - npm - React Testing Library - Semantic HTML - Styled Components - Vite - WebSockets

Backend: Golang - Kubernetes - PostgreSQL - Microservices - Application Monitoring - API Development - MySQL - Datadog - GitHub Actions - Jenkins - ORMs - Postman - Python - Flask

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Created a theming system for client configurable branding of the portal using TypeScript, React, and Material UI 

- Converted hundreds of styled-components to Material UI components, cutting down the time it took to change component styles from days to less than 15 minutes 

- Upgraded the Merchant Portal codebase from Material UI v4 to v5

- Tested all changes with Jest and react-testing-library

- Followed Figma designs to create a pixel-perfect UI

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
- Created a Video Center that’s filterable by camera, time, and the ID of the object of interest (e.g. an engine) using query parameters, Fetch API, Hooks, Redux, and Saga

- Built a Video Player with pinch resizing, fullscreen, frame-by-frame playback, playback speed, debug mode (i.e. overlaid ML output), and custom loading/error screens using React Player, SCSS, Quick Pinch Zoom, Canvas API, and Hooks

- Efficiently turned thousands of sorted and unsorted events into valuable statistics, graph data, and video overlay data with JavaScript and Redux

- Created adjustable analytics dashboards and printable reports pages using query parameters, Fetch API, Hooks, Redux, Carbon UI, SCSS, Chart.js, and React Router

- Took ambiguous wireframes and used JavaScript, React, React Router, SCSS, and Material UI to convert them into attractive, user-friendly components and pages
